protocol.hypothesis: Confirmed wave-2 and wave-4 retracements or an A-B-C correction followed by partial recovery may improve monthly consistency versus same-stock buy-and-hold.

research_provenance.implementation: Adapted causal OHLC geometry, not a reproduction of discretionary Elliott counts or a trader journal.

protocol.signal_semantics: Independent long/short entry signal per stock; not an aggregate portfolio.
protocol.evaluation_unit: One continuous 1000000 RUB account per stock/timeframe/variant; 25% equity per position.
protocol.availability_lag: Pivot at center is known only at close of center+wing; signal on a later completed bar; order fills next open.
protocol.parameter_rationale: Three geometries, two pivot widths, two minimum ZigZag deviations and two recovery fractions. Full 3×2×2×2 grid, no per-stock tuning.
protocol.baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same instrument and timeframe, next-open execution, identical costs.
protocol.signal_rule: Wave2: confirmed L-H-L higher low, 30–80% retrace of first rise; mirror short. Wave4: confirmed L-H-L-H-L with higher highs/lows, nonoverlap of wave 4 with wave 1 and 30–80% retrace of rise 3; mirror short. ABC: confirmed H-L-H-L with B retracing 30–80% of A and C below A; mirror short. Enter on first later close crossing 25% or 50% recovery of last swing, within 20 bars of latest pivot confirmation; if already beyond recovery at first eligible bar, enter then. One entry per setup. Exit long below latest confirmed low, short above latest confirmed high. Pivot confirmations on current close only affect following bars. These are mechanical proxies, not validated subwave counts or diagonal structures.
protocol.execution_timing: Completed signal candle; next bar open fill.
protocol.holding_period: Until opposite signal or confirmed-pivot exit; no fixed expiration.
protocol.rebalance_rule: No periodic rebalance; one position per independent account.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Compare breadth of profitable months, annual PnL, worst month, baseline and neighboring parameters; no automatic paper activation from viewed history.
protocol.research_family: Follow-up to confirmed-impulse-breakout (18 wave3/wave5 variants); 24 correction variants plus baseline here. All periods were viewed before this hypothesis, so no untouched holdout.
limitations: Weekly bars are aggregated from daily bars and stamped at the last trading close; monthly valuation is at last weekly close and may precede calendar month end.
No corporate actions, short borrowing or exchange lots.
Discretionary wave labels are non-unique; only three fixed OHLC proxies are tested.

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.

decision.reason: Вторая волна на 1D улучшила месячную устойчивость относительно прежнего узкого пробоя (медиана 5 из 9 прибыльных месяцев на просмотренном отрезке 2026), но медианная доходность за 2024 была +1.74%, за 2025 +0.27%, январь–сентябрь 2026 +0.42%. У 4H варианта wave2_5_5_50 медиана 4 из 9 прибыльных месяцев, 2025 +0.68%, YTD +1.57%. 1H версии убыточны по медиане 2025, 1W имеют мало сделок и грубую месячную переоценку. Это не подтверждает требуемую регулярную прибыль и не даёт основания запускать новые виртуальные счета. Дальнейшая гипотеза по волне 2 возможна только отдельным заранее зафиксированным тестом, а не выбором постфактум удачных бумаг.
